title: A customer with incomplete details still moves
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves a customer whose record is missing some details, such as an address, to another term.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, {Customer-A}, whose record misses details Edit Customer would ask for (for example no address).
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-17 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-17 Sparse.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button is enabled.
  • Step 4: the toast "1 customer moved to Net 45." shows and no error appears.
  • Step 5: "Credit term" reads Net 45.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R12: “Each moved customer gets the new term (and, under S4-R16, a $0 credit limit) and the S4-R11 note. AccountingHub receives the same customer update an Edit Customer save sends. The customer's other fields are not re-checked, so a customer with incomplete details still moves. No customer update is sent to QuickBooks (S8-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
